placeName.zh-CN: 威尔士康威至加的夫（英国）

note.zh-CN: 2026 年起赛事首次设置单一强制路线，选手在检查点之间不再自由选线。
note.en: Starting 2026 the organisers set a single mandatory route between checkpoints.

details.direction: Point-to-point, north to south: Conwy Castle (North Wales) to Cardiff Castle (South Wales), six consecutive stages across the Carneddau, Glyderau, Snowdon massif, Moelwynion/Rhinogydd, Cadair Idris, Cambrian Mountains, Elan Valley and the Bannau Brycheiniog/Black Mountains.
details.distanceMethod: Official home page states 380 km over six days; this card records the full race total. Per-stage distances are not published on a single official table this round, so no `details.stages` array is written: compiled stage figures from third-party guides appear only in the body table and must not be parsed as official stage mileage. ITRA measured the 2026 edition at 384 km; that measured value is noted separately and is not averaged into the official 380 km figure.
details.elevationMethod: Official home page states 16,400 m of ascent for the Full Dragon. The legacy Ourea events page quoted an older 17,400 m figure for a prior edition, and ITRA's 2026 measurement recorded 16,078 m; both are noted separately and are not averaged with the official figure.
details.attribution: Dragon's Back Race / Ultra X. Registered entrants receive a GPX file of the route and checkpoint locations through the event platform in advance, but no public GPX/KML download URL was located this round; no track is hosted, mirrored or redrawn by this site. Map anchor coordinates are an editorial overview position for Conwy, not a verified start-line precision fix.
